correctness.rationale: Complementary Beatty partition gives exact ordered positive-index convolution for r(n). Its indicator is a fractional rotation interval whose length is piecewise beta-theta, theta-beta, beta for theta in the three stated ranges. Golden-ratio bounded continued-fraction denominators imply uniform O(1) discrepancy per Fibonacci-length block; Zeckendorf decomposition into O(log n) blocks proves uniform error even for n-dependent intervals. Equidistribution of the irrational rotation pushes Lebesgue measure onto density two on (0,beta) plus atom 1-2beta at beta, giving liminf, limsup, mean. Independently compared literal lower+upper representations with convolution for n<=1500 and max finite phase error 1.451; not used as the infinite theorem.
